# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta21

## Unrestricted nearest-edge gate-area insertion

This beta removes the 28 px distance limit introduced in beta20.

- The **first three points** of a new gate area are still placed freely by tapping the map.
- From the fourth point onward, a tap may be made **anywhere on the editable map**.
- The editor always finds the **nearest existing edge** in screen space and inserts the new point between that edge's two endpoints.
- There is **no distance limit** between the tap and the selected edge, so users can create long outward or inward polygon extensions directly instead of first placing a point close to an edge and then dragging it.
- Existing midpoint **+** handles remain available for explicit edge insertion.
- Self-intersection highlighting and Save blocking from beta20 remain unchanged.
- Map pan/zoom remains intentionally disabled while the gate-area editor is active; position and zoom the map before pressing the pencil button.

### Compatibility

Gate-area editing requires **Navimower 0.4.4-beta34 or newer**. No integration-side changes are required for beta21.
